name: Alexander Springs Campground
coordinateNote: Entrance, parking or campsite coordinates from the November 12, 2026 research.
navigationDestination: Alexander Springs Recreation Area, 49525 County Road 445, Altoona, FL 32702
navigationNote: Drive to the listed entrance; follow the access description on arrival.
experience: Sixty-four shaded sites within an easy walk of the Alexander Springs swimming and picnic area. No hookups; hot showers, flush toilets and a dump station. About 16 miles and 28 minutes from Juniper Springs.
access: Book and pay ahead. Stay limit: 14 consecutive days in a 30-day period Ocala WMA general gun season is Nov 14, 2026 - Jan 10, 2027 in the Pipeline, Hopkins Prairie and Lake Delancy units (Church Lake Unit on the far west edge: Nov 14-22 and Nov 28 - Dec 6). FWC 2026-27 brochure: 'During the general gun season, camping is prohibited, except in designated campgrounds and Juniper Prairie Wilderness.' Forest Service: 'Camping is allowed only in designated campsites during general gun season.' This is a designated campground, so it stays legal for the whole trip. Hunters will be on the surrounding forest roads; deer hunters must wear 500 sq in of fluorescent orange, and it is sensible to wear orange on trails outside the campground.

conditions.summary: Availability changes. Compare the saved individual site and night below, then confirm with the operator.

camp.gateHours: Campground gate is locked at 8 p.m. during Daylight Savings (Mar - Oct) and 6 p.m. (Nov - Mar). Failure to do so will lead to a 'no show' charge to your reservation and potential forfeiture of site.
camp.directions: Alexander Springs Recreation Area is located along County Road 445 in the northeast corner of Lake County between Astor and Altoona, Florida. From I-75, take Highway 40 east through Ocala and Silver Springs approximately 40 miles to Highway 19. Go south on Highway 19 approximately 5 miles to Country Road 445. Go east on 445 for 5 miles to the campground. From I-95, take the Ocala/Silver Springs Exit (Highway 40) west for approximately 35 miles to Highway 19. Go south on Highway 19 approximately 5 miles to County Road 445. Go east on 445 for 5 miles to the campground.
